data.title: Elme Communities Repays Secured Loan and Sells Property
data.description:
Elme Communities ( (ELME) ) has provided an update.

On September 14, 2026, Elme Communities fully repaid and terminated a $520 million senior secured term loan from Goldman Sachs Bank USA, which had been secured by first priority mortgages and liens on 10 multifamily properties, after the remaining balance had been reduced to about $198.6 million. The repayment, funded in part by asset sales, resulted in the release of all mortgages and liens on the remaining properties, simplifying the company’s capital structure and removing related loan covenants.

Also on September 14, 2026, a wholly owned subsidiary of Elme Communities completed the previously announced sale of Riverside Apartments, a 1,222-unit community with related undeveloped land in Alexandria, Virginia, to FPA Multifamily, LLC for $250 million, subject to customary adjustments. This transaction, one of several independent sales to the same buyer involving other Elme properties, provided proceeds that helped retire secured debt and continues Elme’s ongoing portfolio repositioning following earlier dispositions in 2025 and 2026.
